# Vendored libraries

Served from this site instead of a CDN, so the app keeps working if a CDN is down
and the Content Security Policy can stay `script-src 'self'`.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `peerjs.min.js` | [PeerJS](https://github.com/peers/peerjs) | 1.5.2 | MIT |
| `qrcode.min.js` | [qrcodejs](https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs) | 1.0.0 | MIT |

Icons in `../icons.js` are from [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) 0.575.0 (ISC).
